description: Partner pack for Circle USDC — regulated stablecoin with native issuance on 16+ chains via CCTP (Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol). Biases toward compliance-sensitive payments, agent micropayments, and native cross-chain rails.

defaults.headline: Build on USDC — regulated stablecoin + CCTP
defaults.subheadline: Native on 16+ chains. CCTP burn-and-mint for native cross-chain transfers — no wrapped assets, no bridge risk.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions USDC, Circle, regulated stablecoin, CCTP, cross-chain USDC transfer, or compliance-focused payments.
firstSteps: Use the Circle Developer Console to provision API keys if the flow needs fiat on/off-ramp (https://console.circle.com).
For cross-chain transfers, prefer CCTP (burn on source, attest via Circle API, mint on destination) over any bridge — CCTP gives native USDC everywhere.
Contract addresses per chain are in partner-config.json.contracts. USDC is a standard ERC-20 — no SafeERC20 shims needed (unlike USDT).
gotchas: CCTP requires a Circle-issued attestation before mint on the destination chain. Expect 13-20 minutes on Ethereum mainnet for the attestation to be available.
USDC on Solana uses SPL Token, not ERC-20 — use the @solana/spl-token SDK.
Circle can freeze addresses via the USDC contract's blacklist. Treasury flows should detect blacklist state before irrevocable swaps.
